final: SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, 'NULL') as hand, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manager_award ma2 JOIN player p2 ON ma2.player_id = p2.player_id) as share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, 'NULL') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
